_doc: c26 actor: per-re-bow level shapes fitted on the first c26 render (stems in /private/tmp/claude-501/mockup-loop/c26-actor/render1). Per track, re-bows in order: 50 ms RMS every 20 ms, smoothed 0.12 s (L). Window k = [0, 1.5 s] after re-bow k: dB = ref - L, where ref runs linearly from the pre level (mean -0.45..-0.1 s, with the previous hold added) by the c25 render's own 3 s-mean level change over the same span (the morendo as c25 played it, before re-bows); after the window the dB holds at target - post (post = mean 1.3..1.5 s) until the next re-bow, and after the last one to the release. Clamped -6..+9 dB. Points [seconds after the re-bow's score onset, dB]; the first point of each list starts at the previous hold.
